headline: Japan to strongly support nation-building efforts of Tarique Rahman administration
summary: Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi pledged closer ties and shared prosperity during bilateral talks with PM Tarique Rahman in Tokyo.
details: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has pledged to work closely with Bangladesh to achieve shared prosperity. During bilateral talks in Tokyo, she expressed her support for the nation-building efforts of the Tarique Rahman administration.

Takaichi highlighted that Bangladesh is a friendly nation sharing values of democracy and the rule of law. She emphasized Bangladesh's strategic importance in realizing a Free and Open Indo-Pacific (FOIP).
The two leaders agreed to elevate the Bay of Bengal Industrial Growth Belt framework into a new strategic initiative titled 'Sharing Prosperity BIG-B'.
Takaichi noted that Bangladesh is vital to the Japanese economy due to its strategic position bridging South and South-East Asia and its domestic market of 170 million people.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman recalled Japan's role as a peace-loving nation and its early diplomatic recognition of Bangladesh, stating that Japan holds a special place in the hearts of the Bangladeshi people.
Under the new strategic partnership, both countries will collaborate through public and private sector initiatives to grow stronger and more prosperous together.
caption:
Japan pledges strong support for Bangladesh's nation-building efforts as bilateral ties reach a new strategic level.

Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has pledged to work closely with Bangladesh to achieve shared prosperity. During bilateral talks in Tokyo, she expressed her support for the nation-building efforts of the Tarique Rahman administration.

Takaichi highlighted that Bangladesh is a friendly nation sharing values of democracy and the rule of law. She emphasized Bangladesh's strategic importance in realizing a Free and Open Indo-Pacific (FOIP).

The two leaders agreed to elevate the Bay of Bengal Industrial Growth Belt framework into a new strategic initiative titled 'Sharing Prosperity BIG-B'.

Takaichi noted that Bangladesh is vital to the Japanese economy due to its strategic position bridging South and South-East Asia and its domestic market of 170 million people.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman recalled Japan's role as a peace-loving nation and its early diplomatic recognition of Bangladesh, stating that Japan holds a special place in the hearts of the Bangladeshi people.

Under the new strategic partnership, both countries will collaborate through public and private sector initiatives to grow stronger and more prosperous together.

headline: Cox's Bazar: 10 tourist bodies handed over to families after resort fire
summary: The remains of the victims were released following DNA tests to confirm their identities.
details: The bodies of 10 tourists who died in a resort fire in Cox's Bazar have been handed over to their respective families.
The handover took place after DNA tests were conducted to accurately identify the victims.
The tragedy occurred when a fire broke out at a resort, claiming the lives of the tourists.
Family members received the remains to perform the final rites.
caption:
10 tourists died in a resort fire in Cox's Bazar. Their bodies have now been handed over to families after DNA identification.

The bodies of 10 tourists who died in a resort fire in Cox's Bazar have been handed over to their respective families.

Family members received the remains to perform the final rites.
